title: 第3700章 为大墓而来第3699章 你们不该来
lines: 那佛像后面的墙壁变成黑色扭曲的漩涡，中间裂开一道缝隙。
缝隙的边缘像被什么利爪撕扯过，裂口处翻卷着细密的黑丝，如同溃烂的伤口边缘伸出的肉芽，缓缓蠕动。
一个黑影从里面缓缓爬出。
黑影是个人形的模样，完全是影子，通体漆黑。
它的身体从裂缝中一寸一寸地挤出来，动作极其缓慢，像一只从蛹中挣脱的虫。
其面部漆黑的五官，诡异地扭曲着，看上去如同在狞笑，给人毛骨悚然的森冷感。
那五官的位置不断变化，眼睛时而移到额头，时而滑到下颌，嘴角的弧度忽而朝上，忽而朝下，像是无数张不同的面孔在同一张脸上交替浮现。
它仿佛在对着君无邪、墨清漓、李总旗三人笑。
画面极其的诡异瘆人。
整个寺庙，死一般的沉寂。
落雪的声音停了，风也停了，仿佛整个世界都在这一刻屏住了呼吸。
君无邪和墨清漓倒是没有什么感觉。
这一生，什么样的诡异与邪恶没有见过？
他们早已习惯。
这种层级，对于他们而言，实在太小儿科了，不值一提。
但是对于李总旗来说，却相当的惊悚，令他心跳加速，通体冰凉。
并非他胆小。
身为镇魔司的总旗，一生不知道面对过多少妖邪。
他自然不是被这诡异东西的样子吓到。
只是，此情此景，那黑影从墙体裂缝中爬出时，散发出的邪恶与诡异的气息，对于李总旗这样的觉醒者而言，实在太过浓烈。
那种气息像粘稠的液体裹住了他的口鼻，渗透进他的每一寸毛孔。
他能感觉到自己的正阳之火在体内不安地跳动，像风中的烛火，随时可能被那股寒意压灭。
这种浓烈的诡异邪恶之气，冲击着他的心神，对他产生了不小的影响。
他的指尖开始发麻，握刀的手腕微微颤抖，视野边缘出现了细碎的黑色斑点，像是有什么东西在阴影中快速爬过。
这时候，佛堂中间，那虚空之中漂浮的血雾，突然暴涨。
暗中的血雾，宛若血海潮水般席卷而来，瞬间就要将整个大殿佛堂淹没。
那血雾翻滚着，里面夹杂着无数细小的气泡，每一个气泡破裂时都发出一声极轻的啵响，像是有什么东西在液体深处张开了嘴。
血雾之中呜啊一声厉叫，声音尖锐无比，刺得人耳膜剧痛。
那声波仿佛穿透了耳朵，宛若钢针般刺入大脑之中。
李总旗只觉得大脑嗡的一声，整颗脑袋一阵剧痛，意识刹那恍惚。
眼前的一切开始旋转，佛堂的墙壁和穹顶扭曲变形。
他猛地捂住脑袋，狠狠甩了甩脑袋，才强行忍住，手里的镇魔刀险些脱手。
刀尖磕在地面的青砖上，迸出一小簇火星，那火星在血雾的映照下红得像一滴血。
与此同时，君无邪身上燃烧的混沌金阳火，直接在空中凝聚成了一轮璀璨大日。
那大日通体由金色火焰构成，核心处却透着一层混沌般的暗金，光芒炽烈而不刺目，像一颗凝缩的太阳悬浮在半空中。
大日冲上佛堂大殿上空，在那血雾暴涨，疯狂弥漫，试图淹没整个佛堂之时，绽放万道混沌金光。
宛若烈阳神日当空，正阳火光普照，克制一切邪恶。
光芒所到之处，阴暗的角落被一寸寸照亮。
可怕的诡异血雾，在接触到混沌金大日之光的刹那，滋滋化为青烟，顷刻间散去。
那青烟带着一股浓烈的焦臭味，散入空气中，像是烧焦的毛发与腐肉混合在一起的气味。
血雾之中，一个血色的诡异身影，挥动利爪，尖叫着扑来。
那身影通体赤红，皮肤表面覆着一层湿漉漉的黏液，双手的指节已经融化成尖锐的骨刺，在混沌金光下泛着暗沉的血光。
它张开嘴，里面漆黑一片，没有牙齿，只有不断涌动的暗红色液体。

;;
The wall behind the Buddha statue turned into a black twisted vortex, with a gap opening in the middle.
The edge of the gap seemed to have been torn by some sharp claws, and fine black threads rolled around the crack, like granulation sprouts protruding from the edge of a festering wound, slowly squirming.
A dark shadow slowly crawled out from inside.
The black shadow looked like a humanoid, completely a shadow, completely black.
Its body squeezed out of the crack inch by inch, moving extremely slowly, like an insect breaking free from its chrysalis.
The dark facial features on his face were weirdly distorted, and he looked like he was grinning, giving people a creepy and cold feeling.
The position of the facial features is constantly changing, the eyes sometimes move to the forehead, sometimes slide to the chin, and the curvature of the corners of the mouth sometimes points upwards, sometimes downwards, like countless different faces appearing alternately on the same face.
It seemed to be smiling at Jun Wuxie, Mo Qingli, and Mr. Li Qi.
The picture is extremely weird and terrifying.
The whole temple was deathly silent.
The sound of falling snow stopped and the wind stopped, as if the whole world held its breath at this moment.
Jun Wuxie and Mo Qingli didn't feel anything at all.
What kind of weirdness and evil have you not seen in this life?
They are already used to it.
For them, this level is too childish and not worth mentioning.
But for Mr. Li, it was quite terrifying, making his heart beat faster and his whole body feel cold.
It's not that he's timid.
As the general banner of the Demon Suppression Division, I have faced countless evil spirits in my life.
Naturally, he was not frightened by the appearance of this strange thing.
However, in this situation, when the black shadow crawled out of the crack in the wall, the evil and strange aura exuded was too strong for an awakened person like Mr. Li.
The breath enveloped his mouth and nose like a thick liquid, seeping into every pore of his body.
He could feel the fire of his righteousness beating uneasily in his body, like a candle flame in the wind, which might be extinguished by the cold at any time.
This strong, strange and evil aura impacted his mind and had a considerable impact on him.
His fingertips began to feel numb, the wrist holding the knife trembled slightly, and tiny black spots appeared on the edge of his vision, as if something was crawling quickly in the shadows.
At this time, in the middle of the Buddhist hall, the blood mist floating in the void suddenly surged.
The dark blood mist swept in like a tide of blood sea, and was about to submerge the entire hall in an instant.
The blood mist was rolling, mixed with countless tiny bubbles. When each bubble burst, it made a very light popping sound, as if something had opened its mouth deep in the liquid.
There was a sharp scream in the blood mist, the sound was so sharp that it hurt people's eardrums.
The sound wave seemed to penetrate the ears and pierce into the brain like a steel needle.
Mr. Li Qi felt his brain buzzing, his whole head was in sharp pain, and his consciousness was in a trance.
Everything in front of him began to spin, and the walls and dome of the temple were twisted and deformed.
He suddenly covered his head and shook it violently before he could hold it back and almost lost the Demon Suppressing Knife in his hand.
The tip of the knife hit the green brick on the ground, and a small cluster of sparks burst out. The sparks were as red as a drop of blood under the blood mist.
At the same time, the chaotic golden sun fire burning on Jun Wuxie's body condensed directly into a bright sun in the sky.
The whole body of the sun was composed of golden flames, but at its core was a layer of chaotic dark gold. The light was blazing but not dazzling, like a condensed sun suspended in mid-air.
The sun rushed into the sky above the main hall of the Buddhist temple. When the blood mist surged and filled the air crazily, trying to submerge the entire Buddhist temple, thousands of chaotic golden lights bloomed.
Just like the blazing sun in the sky, the righteous sun shines brightly, restraining all evil.
Wherever the light reaches, dark corners are illuminated inch by inch.
The terrifying and strange blood mist, the moment it came into contact with the light of the Chaos Golden Sun, turned into blue smoke and dissipated in an instant.
The green smoke carried a strong burnt smell and spread into the air, like the smell of burnt hair mixed with rotten flesh.
In the blood mist, a strange blood-colored figure rushed toward him, waving his sharp claws and screaming.
The figure's entire body was red, and the skin was covered with a layer of wet mucus. The knuckles of his hands had melted into sharp bone spurs, glowing with blood under the chaotic golden light.
It opened its mouth, and it was pitch black inside. There were no teeth, only dark red liquid that was constantly flowing.
